label: Nothing outstanding
note: u_001 has only paid invoices, so the reply says so and cites no amount.
subject: Is my account fully paid?
body: I want to check that every invoice on my account has been settled.

reply_mentions: every invoice on it is paid

label: A payment that failed
note: u_002 has one failed invoice among paid ones; the reply names it and its amount.
subject: My payment did not go through
body: I received a notice that my invoice could not be charged. Can you tell me what happened?

label: An invoice still pending
note: u_003 has a pending invoice. The only static number in the whole reply surface -- 'within 3 business days' -- is in this template, declared in TEMPLATE_SAFE_LITERALS.
subject: Invoice still not collected
body: One of my invoice charges has not gone through yet. Is there a problem with the payment?

label: A session that finished normally
note: u_001's latest session completed. Same user as the first scenario, different intent -- the classifier, not the user, picks the tool.
subject: Did my last charging session finish correctly?
body: I want to confirm the session at the station completed and how much energy it delivered.

label: A session that cut out
note: u_003's latest session was interrupted. The reply states the status word itself, which grounding layer 2 checks against the FactSet.
subject: My charging stopped early
body: The charger at the station cut out before my car was full. What happened to that session?

label: A user with no data at all
note: u_004 exists but has no invoices. An empty result is a handoff, not a cheerful 'you have no invoices' -- zero rows cannot be told apart from a broken upstream join (ADR 0009).
subject: Where are my invoices?
body: I cannot find any invoice or payment history in my account.

label: A user who does not exist
note: u_005 is absent from the fixtures. The API still returns 202: whether a user exists is a fact only a tool can establish, and that belongs in the trace (API.md).
subject: Question about my invoice
body: I would like a copy of my latest invoice and payment receipt.

label: A malformed record upstream
note: u_006's invoice carries an amount that is not a number. The tool fails validation, and the failure reaches the trace as a locator rather than the bad value (TOOLS.md).
subject: Can you resend my last invoice?
body: I need the invoice for my last payment so I can file it for expenses.

label: A question the tools cannot answer
note: No keyword matched. There is no tool for tariffs, station status or support history, so the honest answer is a human (TOOLS.md).
subject: Hello
body: I have a question about my account and would like someone to get back to me.

label: An ambiguous ticket
note: One billing word and one charging word: a tie. Guessing between two templates is the confidently-wrong behaviour the system exists to avoid, so a tie fails closed. The trace carries no keywords, because an unknown intent has no evidence for it (ADR 0012) -- which is why this looks identical to the scenario above.
subject: Problem with my last visit
body: The invoice from the station I used does not look right to me.
